coordinateSystem: x = patient left, y = superior, z = anterior; origin at carina

TR.label: Trachea
TR.name: Trachea
TR.desc: C-shaped cartilage rings anteriorly and laterally; flat posterior membranous wall. Ends at the carina.

RMB.label: RMB
RMB.name: Right main bronchus
RMB.desc: Shorter (~2.5 cm), wider and more vertical than the left, so aspirated material and misplaced tubes favour the right.

LMB.label: LMB
LMB.name: Left main bronchus
LMB.desc: Longer (~5 cm), narrower and more horizontal; passes beneath the aortic arch.

RUL.label: RUL
RUL.name: Right upper lobe bronchus
RUL.desc: Arises laterally from the RMB about 2 cm below the carina and trifurcates into RB1, RB2, RB3.

BI.label: BI
BI.name: Bronchus intermedius
BI.desc: Continuation of the RMB below the RUL origin; ends by dividing into the RML and RLL bronchi.

RML.label: RML
RML.name: Right middle lobe bronchus
RML.desc: Arises anterolaterally from the bronchus intermedius, opposite the superior segment (RB6) of the RLL. Divides into RB4 and RB5.

RLL.label: RLL
RLL.name: Right lower lobe bronchus
RLL.desc: Gives off RB6 (superior segment) posteriorly, then continues as the basal trunk.

RBT.label: RLL basal trunk
RBT.name: Right lower lobe basal trunk
RBT.desc: Divides into the four basal segments: RB7 (medial), RB8 (anterior), RB9 (lateral), RB10 (posterior).

RB1.label: RB1
RB1.name: Apical segment
RB1.desc: RUL trifurcation: RB1 runs superiorly toward the lung apex.

RB2.label: RB2
RB2.name: Posterior segment
RB2.desc: RUL trifurcation: RB2 runs posteriorly and laterally.

RB4.label: RB4
RB4.name: Lateral segment
RB4.desc: RML: RB4 is the lateral of the two segments.

RB5.label: RB5
RB5.name: Medial segment
RB5.desc: RML: RB5 is the medial segment, lying against the heart border.

RB6.label: RB6
RB6.name: Superior segment
RB6.desc: Arises posteriorly from the RLL bronchus, directly opposite the RML origin.

RB7.label: RB7
RB7.name: Medial basal segment
RB7.desc: Medial (cardiac) basal segment; arises medially and anteriorly. Has no separate left counterpart (LB7+8).

RB8.label: RB8
RB8.name: Anterior basal segment
RB8.desc: Anterior basal segment of the RLL.

RB9.label: RB9
RB9.name: Lateral basal segment
RB9.desc: Lateral basal segment of the RLL.

RB10.label: RB10
RB10.name: Posterior basal segment
RB10.desc: Posterior basal segment of the RLL; the most dependent segment when supine.

LUL.label: LUL
LUL.name: Left upper lobe bronchus
LUL.desc: Arises anterolaterally from the LMB and splits into the superior division and the lingular bronchus.

LLL.label: LLL
LLL.name: Left lower lobe bronchus
LLL.desc: Gives off LB6 (superior segment) posteriorly, then continues as the basal trunk.

LING.label: Lingular bronchus
LING.name: Lingular bronchus
LING.desc: Left equivalent of the RML: arises inferiorly from the LUL bronchus and divides into LB4 and LB5.

LBT.label: LLL basal trunk
LBT.name: Left lower lobe basal trunk
LBT.desc: Divides into LB7+8 (anteromedial basal), LB9 (lateral basal) and LB10 (posterior basal).

LB1+2.label: LB1+2
LB1+2.name: Apicoposterior segment
LB1+2.desc: Fused apical and posterior segments of the LUL; runs superiorly and posteriorly.

LB3.label: LB3
LB3.name: Anterior segment
LB3.desc: Anterior segment of the LUL; runs anteriorly.

LB6.label: LB6
LB6.name: Superior segment
LB6.desc: Arises posteriorly from the LLL bronchus at the level of the lingular origin.

LB7+8.label: LB7+8
LB7+8.name: Anteromedial basal segment
LB7+8.desc: Fused medial and anterior basal segments of the LLL.

LB9.label: LB9
LB9.name: Lateral basal segment
LB9.desc: Lateral basal segment of the LLL.

LB10.label: LB10
LB10.name: Posterior basal segment
LB10.desc: Posterior basal segment of the LLL.
